# Japanese (ja) catalog for DiscCraft. F: # an entry is shown in English, the language the strings in code are written in.
# Entries are written from the plain meaning of the English source. So that people who used Adobe
# Encore feel at home, the *terms* (single words and short command names such as エンドアクション,
# 再生リスト, 初期設定ボタン, チャプターポイント, プロジェクトをチェック) follow the wording of the
# Japanese Encore CS6 UI (docs/ui-parity.md §3). Only individual terms are reused; sentences, tooltips
# and messages are written for DiscCraft, and no string table is copied. Product and technology
# names (DiscCraft, DVD-Video, Blu-ray, NTSC, PAL, UDF) keep their spelling.
# House style, so new entries read like the rest:
#   - Menu commands and buttons are short noun phrases with no する/します ending (別名で保存…,
#     ボタンを追加). Tooltips and status messages are です/ます sentences ending in 。
#   - One half-width space between Japanese text and an adjacent Latin word, number or {placeholder}
#     ({count} 個, DVD5 容量). Half-width ":" and "( )", full-width "？". Always "…", never "...".
#   - The long vowel mark is kept (モニター, フォルダー, スライドショー). Terms: 初期設定 (not 既定/デフォルト),
#     オーディオ, ビデオ, 字幕, チャプターポイント, エンドアクション, 再生リスト.
#   - One English source means one Japanese word. Where two UI places need different Japanese
#     (the Buttons heading and a Button label), write different English sources instead of a context.
